headline: Stocks Gain in the First Half of the Day: Here Are the Midweek Figures
summary: The BIST 100 index rose to 13,265.23 points by 1:00 p.m. local time, up 66.39 points or 0.50 percent from the previous close. The gain was recorded during the first half of the session.
why: BIST 100 is the benchmark index of Borsa Istanbul, tracking the largest listed Turkish companies and serving as a gauge of Turkish equity sentiment.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: The index itself is the subject and rose 0.50 percent intraday.
